instruction:
Please act as a professional Verilog designer. Your task is to create a Verilog module that implements a sensor interface for multiple types of sensors, including temperature, pressure, and humidity sensors. 
The module should be able to interface with each sensor and convert its analog output to a digital signal that can be processed by a digital system. 
The module should include the following functionality:

Inputs: a set of analog signals from the sensors (analog_temp, analog_press, analog_humid)
Outputs: a set of digital signals that represent the sensor readings (digital_temp, digital_press, digital_humid)
The module should also have the following parameters:

bits: the number of bits used to represent each sensor reading
voltage_ref: the reference voltage used by the analog-to-digital converter
Your module should implement the following functionality:

The module should use an analog-to-digital converter (ADC) to convert the analog signals from the sensors to digital signals.
The ADC should have a resolution of bits bits.
The ADC should use the voltage_ref reference voltage.
The module should include logic to select which sensor is being read and to route its analog signal to the ADC.
The module should include a multiplexer to select which digital output to send based on which sensor is being read.
To implement the sensor interface, you should use Verilog code to define the ADC and multiplexer functionality. 
You should then use these functions to connect the analog signals from the sensors to the ADC and the digital signals from the ADC to the multiplexer.
Finally, you should use the multiplexer to route the correct digital output based on which sensor is being read.
